verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs describe it as an 'open-source control layer' (autumn-probe-1), which would make self-hosting a fair question, but the evidence pack contains no self-hosting guide, Docker/deployment instructions, or infrastructure requirements — all documentation and CLI references (atmn, MCP, API) point to using Autumn as a hosted SaaS. missing for 10: self-host deployment docs, infrastructure/Docker setup instructions, confirmation of a self-hostable server component.
